title: RTEC Employee Handbook, March 1, 2023 (complete revised archive copy)
revision_evidence: The March 20, 2023 email carrying the PDF calls it a revised version after further changes and asks that it continue to be posted as the 2023 Employee Handbook. No effective date is established.

email_sources.version_note: Later archived copy; email explicitly describes it as revised.
Earlier same-day archived DOCX with the same printed handbook date; content equivalence with the later PDF is not assumed.

searchable_representations.method: Native PDF text extraction with explicit page markers
Ordered extraction of all text nodes from the main document XML, including floating/textbox content, with header/footer text separately included
searchable_representations.coverage: 1509 main-document text nodes across 579 nonempty paragraph/textbox blocks, plus header/footer text; original DOCX remains authoritative for layout and automatic list numbering

review.format_relationship: The PDF and DOCX have distinct SHA-256 hashes and extraction/pagination differences. Word-token comparison shows substantial shared content but does not prove equivalence; both originals are preserved unchanged and the later PDF is treated as the revised archive copy based on its email context.

content_overview: Employment status, complaint routing, equal opportunity, and affirmative action
Workweek, time, overtime, pay, and incentives
Medical, dental, vision, life, retirement, workers' compensation, and other benefits
Sick/personal leave, vacation, holidays, unemployment, jury, funeral, military, and FMLA leave
Solicitation, smoking/tobacco, attendance, harassment, dress, orientation, work rules, and safety by role
Confidentiality, progressive discipline, disciplinary guideline groups, communications systems, nepotism/fraternization, and audio/video surveillance
Employee handbook receipt certificate on page 48

relationships.note: The earlier corpus item contains only eight selected pages from a 48-page handbook. This archived copy provides a complete 48-page text source for the same printed handbook date.
The complete December 15, 2025 handbook is later and is the currentest complete handbook in the corpus; later standalone policies may control individual sections.
The 2023 handbook records an EEO Officer assignment; the later signed 2026 EEO source is the later evidence for that role assignment.

authority_and_cautions: This is historical handbook evidence, not current operational guidance.
Do not generalize 2023 benefit, leave, attendance, discipline, or legal statements as current without checking later authoritative sources.
Text extraction includes line-wrap and character-recognition artifacts; use the unchanged source artifact for exact wording and layout.

The employee-note page and page-48 receipt are blank. Official names/signatures in this position-level policy source are retained under the corpus full-source rule; no employee/applicant case records are included.
